aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description: MedsKai is a digital learning platform dedicated to medical education. We deliver structured, evidence-based training programs led by distinguished experts across applied medical fields.
aboutUs.missionContent: To provide structured, evidence-based, and practice-oriented learning that builds clinical readiness, verified skills, and stronger career pathways.
aboutUs.visionContent: To become the leading healthcare EdTech ecosystem for Applied Medical and Health Sciences in Egypt and the MENA region.
aboutUs.introSubtitle: A healthcare learning ecosystem built for real clinical readiness.
aboutUs.introDesc: MedSkAi is not just a course platform. We connect structured specialty learning, practical case-based training, verified certificates, professional communities, and career pathways to help applied health learners move from academic knowledge to real healthcare practice.

goalsList.regular: designed by experienced instructors and reviewed academically.

aboutUs.trustedByTitle: Trusted By The Next Generation Of Healthcare Talents
aboutUs.trustedByDesc: MedSkAi Is Trusted By 1,200+ Students And Graduates Across 17+ Universities, Starting From Egypt And Growing Toward A Wider Global Healthcare Learning Community.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introductionText: MedsKai is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and services.
privacyPolicy.dataCollectionText:
We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:
• Account information (name, email, password)
• Profile information (bio, avatar)
• Course progress and completion data
• Payment information for course purchases
• Device information and usage data
privacyPolicy.dataUsageText:
We use the information we collect to:
• Provide and maintain our services
• Process transactions and send related information
• Send notifications about your courses
• Improve our services and develop new features
• Respond to your comments and questions
privacyPolicy.dataSecurityText: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyText: We may share information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing, data analysis, and email delivery.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our service and hold certain information to improve your experience.
privacyPolicy.rightsText:
You have the right to:
• Access your personal data
• Correct inaccurate data
• Request deletion of your data
• Opt-out of marketing communications
• Export your data
privacyPolicy.contactText:
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
Email: privacy@medskai.com

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.acceptanceText: By accessing or using MedsKai's services, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.
terms.servicesText: MedsKai provides online medical education courses, learning materials, and certification programs for healthcare professionals. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue any service at any time.
terms.accountsText:
You are responsible for:
• Maintaining the confidentiality of your account
• All activities that occur under your account
• Notifying us of any unauthorized use
• Providing accurate and complete information
terms.paymentText:
• Course fees are non-refundable unless otherwise stated
• Membership subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled
• All prices are subject to change with notice
• You agree to pay all charges at the prices in effect
terms.intellectualText: All content on MedsKai, including courses, videos, images, and text, is the property of MedsKai or its content suppliers. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without permission.
terms.prohibitedText:
You agree not to:
• Share your account credentials
• Download or distribute course content
• Use the service for unlawful purposes
• Attempt to gain unauthorized access
• Interfere with the service's operation
terms.terminationText: We may terminate or suspend your account at any time for violations of these terms. Upon termination, your right to use the service will immediately cease.
terms.liabilityText: MedsKai shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of or inability to use the service.
terms.changesText: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or in-app notification.
terms.contactText:
For questions about these Terms, contact us at:
Email: legal@medskai.com
